notes.title: Update report - bug fixed
notes.notes:
At present, the collected typographical / person name display bugs have been fixed. There may be a few errors, please continue to report to us!

Only a few lines of the history of the backlog interface have been fixed. You can see a lot of historical information!

If there is no automatic update, please manually check the update before the game starts.


We use Utage3 to develop the game for the first time. There are inevitably omissions. 
We welcome feedback. We will fix it as soon as we receive it!
